farmer_question: How do I check if my name is on the list to receive the ₹6,000 yearly income support under PM-KISAN?
target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers across India
benefit_details: Provides income support of Rs 6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of Rs 2,000 directly transferred to bank accounts (DBT).
eligibility_criteria: Landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares in official land records.
how_to_apply: Check beneficiary status at pmkisan.gov.in under 'Farmers Corner' -> 'Beneficiary List', or visit local CSC center.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Record (Khasra/Khatauni), Bank Account linked with Aadhaar.

farmer_question: If my bank account is not linked to my Aadhaar card, will my PM-KISAN scheme benefits stop?
target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers
benefit_details: Aadhaar-seeded bank account is mandatory for receiving direct benefit transfer (DBT) installments.
eligibility_criteria: Aadhaar e-KYC must be completed on pmkisan.gov.in portal or via biometric verification at CSC.
how_to_apply: Link Aadhaar with bank account at home bank branch or post office savings bank.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.

farmer_question: What should I do if the government website shows PM-KISAN money was sent, but it is not in my bank account?
target_beneficiary: PM-KISAN Beneficiary Farmers
benefit_details: Resolves failed DBT transactions due to bank account credit freeze or incorrect IFSC/account details.
eligibility_criteria: Verify NPCI mapping status and DBT credit log on pmkisan.gov.in portal.
how_to_apply: Contact PM-KISAN Helpdesk (155261 / 011-24300606) or submit grievance on Public Grievance Portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Statement, Registration Number.

farmer_question: How do I enroll my crops in the PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY), and what is the last date to apply?
target_beneficiary: All farmers growing notified crops including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
benefit_details: Comprehensive crop insurance cover against yield losses caused by natural disasters (drought, flood, pest attack).
eligibility_criteria: Enrollment cutoff date is July 31 for Kharif crops and December 31 for Rabi crops.
how_to_apply: Enroll online at pmfby.gov.in portal, via bank branch, CSC center, or insurance company representative.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Sowing Certificate (LPC), Land Ownership/Tenancy Papers.

farmer_question: How much money (premium) do I have to pay out of my own pocket to insure one acre of land under PMFBY?
target_beneficiary: Insured Farmers
benefit_details: Maximum farmer premium is 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for Annual Commercial/Horticultural crops.
eligibility_criteria: Government subsidizes remaining 90%+ premium cost equally between State and Central Governments.
how_to_apply: Premium calculation is automated on PMFBY portal insurance premium calculator.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Crop Sowing Details.

farmer_question: If heavy rains or drought destroy my harvest, whom do I contact immediately to claim PMFBY insurance money?
target_beneficiary: Farmers facing localized natural disasters or post-harvest losses
benefit_details: Localized calamity loss compensation for inundation, landslide, hail, or drought within 72 hours of damage.
eligibility_criteria: Loss intimation must be reported within 72 hours of occurrence.
how_to_apply: Report loss via Crop Insurance App, call toll-free helpline (14447), or inform District Agriculture Officer / Bank.
documents_required: Policy/Application Number, Photos of damaged crop field, Bank Account Details.

farmer_question: How many days does the insurance company take to visit my farm and check the damage after a storm?
target_beneficiary: Affected Insured Farmers
benefit_details: Joint survey assessment conducted by Insurance Representative and State Agriculture Department official.
eligibility_criteria: Joint survey must be completed within 10 days of intimation, and claim settled within 15 days of survey.
how_to_apply: Track loss claim status on PMFBY portal using Claim Tracking ID.
documents_required: Intimation Slip / Application ID.

farmer_question: Can I still get crop insurance under PMFBY if I am farming on leased land and do not own the land papers?
target_beneficiary: Tenant Farmers and Sharecroppers
benefit_details: Provides full crop insurance benefits to non-loanee tenant farmers without requiring land ownership title.
eligibility_criteria: Tenant agreement declaration or Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Sarpanch / Village Revenue Officer.
how_to_apply: Submit tenancy agreement / self-declaration form at nearest CSC center or Bank branch.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Tenancy Agreement / Village Sowing Certificate.

farmer_question: How to get low interest loan using Kisan Credit Card (KCC), and is 4 percent interest rate valid for 3 lakh loan?
target_beneficiary: Farmers, Tenant Farmers, Animal Husbandry & Fisheries Farmers
benefit_details: Short-term crop credit loans up to Rs 3 Lakh at effective 4% per annum (7% base rate with 3% prompt repayment incentive).
eligibility_criteria: All practicing farmers, joint liability groups, and SHGs engaged in agriculture or allied activities.
how_to_apply: Fill 1-page KCC application form at any Commercial Bank, RRB, or Cooperative Bank branch.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Land Revenue Records (7/12 extract / Khatauni), Passport photos.

farmer_question: What financial help can I get from the government to install a drip or sprinkler irrigation system?
scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
target_beneficiary: Farmers adopting Micro-Irrigation (Drip & Sprinkler Systems)
benefit_details: Subsidies ranging from 45% (general category) to 55% (small/marginal/women/SC/ST farmers) for installing drip & sprinkler systems.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers possessing land with assured water source (borewell, pond, canal).
how_to_apply: Apply online at State Horticulture/Agriculture portal or District Horticulture Office.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Proof, Bank Passbook, Soil & Water Test Report.

farmer_question: Is there a government scheme that pays for digging a farm pond or a tube well on my land to store rainwater?
scheme_name: PMKSY Watershed Development Component & MGNREGA Farm Ponds
target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers in Rainfed Areas
benefit_details: 100% grant for constructing farm ponds (Khet Talab), check dams, and dug wells for rainwater harvesting.
eligibility_criteria: Rural landholding farmers participating in watershed development project areas or MGNREGA job card holders.
how_to_apply: Submit application to Gram Panchayat office or District Watershed Development Officer.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, MGNREGA Job Card, Land Khasra Map.

farmer_question: How can I get a subsidy to buy a solar water pump for irrigation, and how much does PM-KUSUM pay?
target_beneficiary: Farmers in off-grid areas needing irrigation pumps
benefit_details: Provides up to 60% subsidy (30% Central + 30% State Govt) for installing standalone solar agriculture pumps (3 HP to 10 HP).
eligibility_criteria: Farmers owning agricultural land without grid electricity connection for irrigation.
how_to_apply: Apply online on State Renewable Energy Agency portal (e.g. UPNEDA, HAREDA, MAHADISCOM).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Certificate, Bank Passbook, Mobile Number.

farmer_question: How can a farmer reduce electricity bills and earn extra money by selling solar power under PM-KUSUM?
scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri KUSUM Yojana (Component A & C)
target_beneficiary: Farmers with grid-connected pumps or barren farmland
benefit_details: Solarize grid pumps and sell excess solar electricity back to DISCOM grid at tariff rates (Rs 3-5 per kWh).
eligibility_criteria: Farmers owning grid-connected agricultural pumps or barren/uncultivable land within 5 km of DISCOM substation.
how_to_apply: Register on DISCOM solar portal or State Nodal Renewable Energy Agency website.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Electricity Connection Account Number, Land Record, Bank Details.

farmer_question: How do I register on the e-NAM digital market platform to sell my produce to buyers outside my local area?
target_beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, APMC Mandi Traders
benefit_details: Pan-India electronic trading portal integrating 1,360+ APMC mandis for online bidding, real-time price discovery, and direct DBT payment.
eligibility_criteria: Free registration for any farmer bringing agricultural produce to connected e-NAM mandis.
how_to_apply: Register online at enam.gov.in portal, via e-NAM mobile app, or at mandi entry gate registration counter.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Mobile Number.

farmer_question: How and where can I sell my crops at the government-fixed Minimum Support Price (MSP)?
scheme_name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) & State Procurement Centers
target_beneficiary: Grain, Pulse, and Oilseed Farmers
benefit_details: Direct government procurement at MSP rates for Wheat, Paddy, Pulses, and Oilseeds with direct bank credit within 48 hours.
eligibility_criteria: Pre-registration on State Paddy/Wheat Procurement Portal before harvest season.
how_to_apply: Register on State Food & Civil Supplies Procurement portal or visit nearest State Procurement Center / APMC Mandi.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Sowing Certificate (Pahani / Khasra), Bank Account Passbook.

farmer_question: How can I get a government subsidy to buy a tractor, rotavator, or combine harvester?
target_beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, Rural Youth Entrepreneurs
benefit_details: Provides 40% to 80% subsidy for purchasing farm machinery (tractors, power tillers, rotavators, harvesters) and setting up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
eligibility_criteria: Small, marginal, women, and SC/ST farmers get 50% to 80% subsidy priority.
how_to_apply: Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in portal or via FARMS mobile app.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Proof, Bank Passbook, Category/Caste Certificate (if applicable).

farmer_question: Are there specific government rewards, certifications, or financial packages if I switch to organic farming?
scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) & Organic Farming
target_beneficiary: Farmers forming clusters for organic farming
benefit_details: Financial assistance of Rs 50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, vermicompost, PGS certification, and eco-packaging.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers forming clusters of 20 or more hectares (50 farmers) adopting organic farming practices.
how_to_apply: Contact District Agriculture Officer or Regional Executive Agency under PKVY scheme.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Cluster Group Registration Form.

farmer_question: Can I get a subsidy or low interest loan to build a small cold storage unit or warehouse in my village?
target_beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, Agri-Entrepreneurs, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS)
benefit_details: Interest subvention loan at 3% per annum for credit up to Rs 2 Crore for post-harvest infrastructure (cold chains, warehouses, sorting units).
eligibility_criteria: Setting up post-harvest agricultural management infrastructure or community farming assets.
how_to_apply: Submit loan application online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR), Entity Registration, Land Lease/Ownership Document, Bank Details.

farmer_question: Is there a pension scheme for small farmers above 60 years of age, and how much pension is guaranteed?
target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers aged 18 to 40 years
benefit_details: Voluntary pension scheme guaranteeing minimum Rs 3,000 per month pension after attaining 60 years of age.
eligibility_criteria: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land up to 2 hectares, aged 18 to 40 years. Monthly contribution Rs 55 to Rs 200.
how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest CSC center or self-register on pmkmy.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Savings Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar.

farmer_question: How can I get a Soil Health Card for my farm to know the exact fertilizer dosage needed for my soil?
target_beneficiary: All landholding farmers across Indian states
benefit_details: Provides free Soil Health Card reporting 12 soil parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) with crop-wise fertilizer recommendations.
eligibility_criteria: Issued free of cost every 3 years following government soil sample testing.
how_to_apply: Soil samples collected by agriculture extension staff or submitted directly at District Soil Testing Laboratory.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Survey Number (Khasra Number).

farmer_question: How can I get a 50% subsidy to start a goat, sheep, or poultry livestock farming business in my village?
target_beneficiary: Rural Youth, Farmers, SHGs, FPOs engaged in Animal Husbandry
benefit_details: Provides 50% capital subsidy up to Rs 50 Lakh for establishing goat/sheep breeding farms, poultry farms, and fodder seed units.
eligibility_criteria: Individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs, and JLGs with suitable land and water facility for livestock.
how_to_apply: Apply online through NLM portal (nlm.udyamimitra.in) or State Animal Husbandry Department.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Animal Husbandry Training Certificate, Bank Account Details.

farmer_question: How can I get a subsidy to buy an agricultural drone for spraying pesticides and fertilizers on my crops?
target_beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, Agri-Graduates, Custom Hiring Centres
benefit_details: Subsidies up to 75% for small/marginal/women farmers and 50% for Agri-Graduates to purchase Kisan Drones for spraying.
eligibility_criteria: Certified Remote Pilot License holders or FPOs offering custom hiring spraying services.
how_to_apply: Apply online on agrimachinery.nic.in portal under Drone Sub-Mission.
documents_required: Remote Drone Pilot License, Aadhaar Card, Land Record / FPO Certificate, Bank Passbook.

farmer_question: Are there special collateral-free bank loans available for Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) doing farming?
scheme_name: DAY-NRLM (Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission)
target_beneficiary: Rural Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs)
benefit_details: Collateral-free bank loans up to Rs 20 Lakh for Women SHGs at interest subvention rate down to 7% per annum.
eligibility_criteria: Women SHGs practicing Panchasutra guidelines registered under NRLM for 6+ months.
how_to_apply: Apply through Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) or Gram Panchayat SHG Federation.
documents_required: SHG Meeting Resolution, Bank Passbook, Member Aadhaar Cards.

farmer_question: How can I get a 35% subsidy to set up a small food processing unit like flour milling, spice grinding, or jaggery making?
scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
target_beneficiary: Micro Food Processing Entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs
benefit_details: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% up to maximum Rs 10 Lakh for upgrading or establishing micro food processing enterprises.
eligibility_criteria: Existing or new micro food processing unit owners aged above 18 years.
how_to_apply: Apply online on pmfme.mofpi.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Business Project Report (DPR), Bank Passbook.

farmer_question: What government financial assistance or subsidy is available for fish pond construction and fish farming?
target_beneficiary: Fish Farmers, Fishers, Fisheries Cooperatives
benefit_details: Provides 40% (general category) to 60% (women/SC/ST) subsidy for constructing fish ponds, biofloc units, and purchasing fish feed.
eligibility_criteria: Individual fish farmers or landholders with suitable water body/pond area.
how_to_apply: Submit proposal to District Fisheries Office or online via pmmsy.dof.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land/Pond Document, Bank Passbook, Fisheries License.

farmer_question: How do I get financial assistance for setting up a polyhouse or shade net house for vegetable and flower farming?
scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
target_beneficiary: Horticulture and Vegetable Farmers
benefit_details: Subsidies up to 50% for establishing protected cultivation structures (polyhouses, shade net houses, plastic mulching).
eligibility_criteria: Farmers possessing suitable agricultural land for high-value horticulture crops.
how_to_apply: Apply online at midh.gov.in or through District Horticulture Office.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Record (Khasra/Khatauni), Bank Account Details.

farmer_question: How can I get a subsidy for purchasing bee hives and honey extraction equipment under Sweet Revolution?
target_beneficiary: Beekeepers, Farmers, SHGs, FPOs
benefit_details: Up to 80% subsidy for purchasing bee colonies, bee hives, honey extractors, and honey processing units.
eligibility_criteria: Registered beekeepers or farmers trained in beekeeping by KVKs or National Bee Board.
how_to_apply: Register on Madhukranti portal (nbhm.gov.in) and submit application to National Bee Board.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Beekeeping Training Certificate, Bank Passbook.

farmer_question: How can 300 farmers join together to form a Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) and get ₹18 Lakh government support?
scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme for 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
target_beneficiary: Small Farmer Collectives and FPOs
benefit_details: Financial support of Rs 18 Lakh per FPO over 3 years for management, matching equity grant up to Rs 15 Lakh, and credit guarantee up to Rs 2 Crore.
eligibility_criteria: Minimum 300 farmer members in plains (100 in hilly regions) forming a registered FPO under Companies Act / Cooperatives.
how_to_apply: Apply through Implementing Agencies (NABARD, SFAC, NCDC) or FPO promotion portal.
documents_required: FPO Incorporation Certificate, Board of Directors List, Member List with Aadhaar IDs.

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP)
farmer_question: Is there a direct subsidy available to help me buy certified high-yielding seeds before the sowing season starts?
target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers across all states
benefit_details: Distribution of certified high-yielding hybrid seeds at 50% subsidized rates under Seed Village Program.
eligibility_criteria: All practicing farmers participating in Seed Village clusters.
how_to_apply: Contact local Assistant Agriculture Officer (AAO) or Gram Panchayat Agriculture Extension Worker.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card and Land Record Details.

farmer_question: Do I need to visit a government office in the city to apply for schemes, or can I do it at the local CSC center in my village?
target_beneficiary: All Rural Citizens and Farmers
benefit_details: Enables online application for all Central and State government schemes (PM-KISAN, PMFBY, KCC, PM-KUSUM, e-NAM) right inside the village.
eligibility_criteria: Available to all rural citizens at nominal user fee (Rs 15-30).
how_to_apply: Visit your nearest Village Common Service Centre (CSC / Digital Seva Kendra) with required documents.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Mobile Number, Bank Passbook.
